submitted.rationale: XRD shows a single cubic phase (with peaks at Q≈2.78, 4.55 and 5.33) that dominates the Mg-rich side. Toward the Sb-rich end, trirutile MgSb2O6-like reflections (Q≈1.91, 3.22) appear. EQE rose with Sb content: idx13 ≈ -6e-5%, idx23 4.3e-4%, idx26 1.06e-3%. All values are tiny, which fits wide-gap oxides under 2.7 eV light. The most Sb-rich composition (idx26) measured highest.
